method: Image generation with existing scene art as style reference; image packing performs format conversion and proportional resize only. Original art untouched.
notes: The human-opponents atlas supersedes nine candidate creature cells. Only the 36 IDs in briefs-v24 are active additions; unused draft cells are never displayed or counted as playable enemies.

atlases.prompt:
Create an original game-ready transparent enemy sprite atlas for Chronicle Gate. The supplied image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: preserve its muted slate navy, dusty lavender, aged ivory, restrained warm light, hand-placed pixel clusters, matte limited palette and quiet storybook mood. Do not copy the reference scenery. This is a single square 2 by 2 ATLAS of FOUR ENTIRELY DIFFERENT enemies, one fully visible creature/group centered in each exact quadrant. Transparent background. No scenery, floor, frame, border, panels, text, names, numbers, labels or UI. No repeated poses or color-swapped reskins. Match pixel art, NOT glossy digital concept art, not 3D, not anime portraits, not excessive glow, not smooth painted photorealism. Deliberate irregular silhouette, chunky pixel clusters and clear readable silhouette at 300 pixels. Orthographic or slight 3/4 game combat view, each facing slightly left toward player. Four equal square cells with generous empty transparency margins on ALL sides of each entire silhouette: keep every asset entirely within the central 76% of its quadrant, including wings/tails/shadows. Leave a wide transparent gutter along the vertical and horizontal center seams. All four enemies similar visual scale. No ground shadow outside creature silhouette. All body parts uncut. Enemies are eerie, worn, expressive objects/creatures, not cute mascots. Their forms MUST match these quadrant-specific briefs precisely:

TOP LEFT: 짐표를 두른 분실물 짐승. Low quadruped made of two worn leather suitcases and folded lost umbrellas; many blank paper baggage tags form a shaggy mane, one suitcase handle curls like a tail; brass buckles and dark violet cloth, no human face. The tags rustle as it guards lost property. Palette: worn brown leather, slate navy, aged ivory paper.

TOP RIGHT: 철길을 지키는 녹슨 사냥개. Long-legged maintenance hound built from rusty rail brackets and old signal mechanisms, tapered railway-lamp snout, steel paw clamps, loose chain tail. Clearly canine silhouette and practical worn machine, dim red signal eye. Palette: rust umber, slate iron, muted red.

BOTTOM LEFT: 목소리를 삼킨 방송나방. Large spectral moth with charcoal velvety body and broad wings made of coiled magnetic recording tape; pale sound-wave stripes, small antennae resembling twin old radio aerials. A dim amber glow in abdomen, no lettering. Palette: charcoal violet, faded tape brown, pale amber.

BOTTOM RIGHT: 침목 아래의 신호거미. Low eight-legged spider assembled from dark wooden railway sleeper fragments, railway nails and jointed signal rods. Small cracked lantern carried on its back, fine copper wires stretch between limbs; no humanoid parts. Palette: dark timber, worn brass, dull green lamp.

Output one clean transparent 2x2 sprite sheet only. The four cell boundaries are at exactly 50% width/height. No grid lines. Every creature lies well inside its cell. The reference picture stays untouched; this is an additional compatible asset.
